Title: Quark Pancakes
Ingredients:
1. 1 cup 5% quark (soft white cheese)
2. 2 eggs
3. ½ cup all-purpose flour
4. 2 tbsp silan (date syrup)
5. 1 cup heavy cream
6. 4 petit beurre biscuits
Steps:
1. Mix the quark (soft white cheese) with the eggs and all-purpose flour to make a thick batter.
2. Drop spoonfuls of batter into a greased skillet and fry until golden on both sides.
3. Whip the heavy cream until fluffy.
4. Serve with the whipped cream, crumbled petit beurre biscuits, and silan (date syrup).
